name: Do I need to hire a separate finish carpenter or can my general contractor handle it?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate finish carpenter or can my general contractor handle it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many general contractors, including City Dweller, LLC, have skilled finish carpenters on staff or work with trusted subcontractors who specialize in this craft. Hiring a general contractor who oversees finish carpentry as part of the overall project can streamline communication, ensure better coordination between trades, and simplify project management. It often provides a more cohesive timeline and a single point of contact, rather than managing multiple independent contractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor can often handle or oversee finish carpentry, simplifying project management and ensuring coordination with other trades.
